basics.name: Eugene Hyrol
basics.label: Senior iOS Engineer & Technical Lead
basics.summary: Senior iOS Engineer & Technical Lead with 9+ years of experience building secure, high-scale iOS applications in banking, e-commerce, and logistics. Specializing in SwiftUI with hands-on depth in UIKit, modular architectures, app security, and leading cross-functional iOS, React Native, and Flutter engineering teams. Focused on technical excellence while understanding business language.

work.position: Manager · Mobile Tech Lead & Senior iOS Engineer
work.summary: Leading mobile initiatives across banking and retail AI applications, orchestrating multi-disciplinary engineering teams while remaining hands-on with iOS architecture.

subProjects.name: Mobile Banking E-Commerce Module
points: Led a cross-functional team of 15 FTEs (iOS, Android, Backend, QA) building an e-commerce banking module for a tier-1 Polish bank.
Delivered hands-on SwiftUI architecture in a modular, multi-team codebase with unit tests, screenshot regression tests, and automated E2E suites.
Coordinated feature integration, strict security compliance, Scrum ceremonies, and root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents.

subProjects.name: E-Grocery AI Assistant Module
points: Led end-to-end development of an AI-based shopping assistant for a leading Polish e-grocery platform (3 backend, 3 frontend, 2 QA).
Guided the architectural transition from Flutter PoC to production React Native module, successfully launching to customers in August 2025.

work.summary: Led mobile security audits and enterprise UI component engineering for automotive and financial clients.
highlights: Executed technical security audits for automotive iOS apps: remediated static/dynamic analysis vulnerabilities, implemented secure Keychain storage, and hardened network transport against MITM attacks.
Designed and implemented a reusable UI Component Library in SwiftUI adhering to Atomic Design principles.
Mentored junior developers, conducted technical interviews for iOS candidates across all levels, and aligned closely with security specialists.

work.summary: Led an iOS development team on core mobile banking products, security authorization protocols, and greenfield applications.
highlights: Led a team of 5 iOS developers, driving technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, and rigorous code reviews.
Implemented 3D Secure transaction authorization by integrating a third-party biometric and cryptographic SDK.
Designed and coordinated greenfield architecture for a new mobile banking app targeting a fresh customer demographic.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) for production defects, boosting crash-free session rates.

work.summary: Enhanced core banking mobile features, security hardening, and developer tooling automation.
highlights: Integrated automated project generation tooling (xcodegen), eliminating Git merge conflicts across large engineering teams.
Implemented TLS certificate pinning and jailbreak detection mechanisms conforming to OWASP mobile security standards.
Mentored incoming junior iOS developers on Swift idioms and architectural patterns.

work.summary: Pioneered internationalization and adaptation of flagship banking solutions for international markets.
highlights: Kicked off internationalization engineering adapting a major Polish banking app to the French market.
Conducted technical feasibility studies, led live client demo sessions, and partnered with DevOps to establish automated CI/CD pipelines.

work.summary: Built full-lifecycle native iOS applications featuring offline persistence, live media streaming, and in-app transactions.
highlights: Developed a comprehensive Bible reader iOS app featuring verse bookmarking, highlighting, cloud data synchronization, and StoreKit In-App Purchases.
Engineered a real estate client app enabling live video property tours and cloud archiving using the Twilio SDK.
Mentored junior team members in Objective-C, memory management, and Cocoa Touch frameworks.

projects.name: Mobile Banking E-Commerce & 3D Secure
projects.description: High-scale modular iOS banking application serving millions of Polish banking clients, featuring secure e-commerce, biometric authentication, and 3D Secure payments.
highlights: Modular architecture with SwiftUI, XCTest, and Snapshot screenshot regression tests
TLS pinning, jailbreak detection, and biometric authorization meeting strict banking regulations

projects.name: E-Grocery AI Assistant Module
projects.description: AI-powered shopping assistant integrated into a leading Polish e-grocery app, accelerating user checkout and recipe item discovery.
highlights: Architected PoC in Flutter, delivered production cross-platform module in React Native
Released to live consumer market in August 2025

projects.name: Atomic SwiftUI Component Library
projects.description: Reusable UI system adhering to Atomic Design principles, enabling consistent, accessible interface design across multiple automotive and enterprise apps.
highlights: Cross-team reusable tokens, accessible typography, and theme styling
Significantly accelerated prototyping and feature development

projects.name: WalkieTalkie (Open Source)
projects.description: Real-time low-latency iOS audio transmission app communicating via custom UDP socket streaming and background audio handling.
highlights: Low-latency UDP packet streaming and buffer manipulation in Swift
Automated background audio reconnection

education.description: Advanced coursework in distributed systems, software architecture, algorithm design, and software engineering.
